instructions: Classify one leaf clause for a reading view. Choose for you when the clause is written for someone who uses the result. Choose internals when it explains implementation, authoring, review mechanics, or operation rather than the result itself.

labels.name: for you
labels.description: Written for someone who uses the result or needs to understand its user-visible behavior.

input.clause: As a reviewer away from the authoring machine, I want to comment and finish from an ordinary mobile browser using one secret link so review requires no SSH or separate account.
input.reader: someone who uses the result, not builds it

input.clause: When the reviewer picks a listed commit, highlighting and bar reflect that base without a page reload, and the URL carries focus=changes&base=<full id>.
input.reader: someone who uses the result, not builds it

labels.name: internals
labels.description: Explains implementation, authoring, review mechanics, or operation instead of the result for its user.

input.clause: The implementation adds no generic supervisor or agent-launching server.
